curriculum.label: Lessons
curriculum.emptyHint: Plan an improvement from feedback on a group’s or a course’s Feedback tab.

lanes.groupEmpty: No changes to this group’s lessons yet.
lanes.groupFeedbackEmpty: No improvements from this group's feedback yet.

page.title: Improvements
page.description: Every change being made, from feedback and notes: one lane per course (its own lessons) and per group (its copy). Drag a card between columns to change its status. Each group's and course's own changes are also on its Feedback tab.
page.empty: No curricula to show here yet.
page.doneLimit: Done shows the {count} most recently finished improvements.

detailPage.title: Improvement
detailPage.description: What should change in the lesson, why, and the plan to change it.

board.untiedTasks: {count, plural, one {# untied improvement} other {# untied improvements}}
board.ignoredTasks: {count, plural, one {# ignored improvement} other {# ignored improvements}}
board.created: Created {unit, select, today {today} days {{count}d ago} weeks {{count}w ago} months {{count}mo ago} other {{count}y ago}}
board.age: {unit, select, today {today} days {{count}d} weeks {{count}w} months {{count}mo} other {{count}y}}
board.aiTitle: Cleared for the local agent: it may execute this revision on its own
board.notes: {count, plural, one {# discussion note} other {# discussion notes}}

confirm.title: Delete improvement
confirm.description: Permanently deletes {what}, {mode, select, ignored {{count, plural, one {which was ignored} other {which were ignored}}} other {{count, plural, one {which is not tied to any curriculum} other {which are not tied to any curriculum}}}}. Discussion notes go too. This cannot be undone.

workflow.title: Workflow
workflow.hint: Who is on this improvement, how far along it is, and whether the agent may run with it. All save as soon as you pick.

whose.title: Where the change goes
whose.group: This improvement changes <link>{group}</link>'s own copy of the lessons only. The course's own lessons stay as they are.
whose.alreadySuggested: Already suggested for the course as <task>{title}</task> ({status}).
whose.suggestHint: Should the course's own lessons get this change too? Suggest it for the course: that makes a linked improvement on the course for whoever manages it to accept or decline. This group's improvement stays as it is.
whose.course: This improvement changes the course’s own lessons: new groups start from them. Groups that already have their own copy keep theirs.
whose.suggestedFrom: Suggested for the course from the group improvement <task>{title}</task> ({status}).
whose.both: This improvement changes <link>{group}</link>'s copy and the main course's lesson it came from. Saving the group's copy puts the same changes on the main course's lesson, to review there. It's done when both are saved.

plan.title: Revision plan
plan.hint: What the revision does. Write it here or in the lesson's Obsidian feedback note: it's the same plan.
plan.hintUpdated: What the revision does. Write it here or in the lesson's Obsidian feedback note: it's the same plan · updated {date}.
plan.hintApp: What the revision does: what changes, where and why.
plan.hintAppUpdated: What the revision does: what changes, where and why · updated {date}.
plan.readHint: What the improvement does: what changes, where and why. It’s planned in the lesson, with AI.
plan.readHintVault: What the improvement does. It’s planned in the lesson, with AI, or in the lesson’s Obsidian feedback note.

instructions.title: Notes for whoever does it
instructions.hint: Anything they should know before changing the lesson. What learners said is under Feedback above.
instructions.placeholder: What should change in the lesson?

clear.title: Clear this improvement
clear.hint: Ignored means the revision was looked at and turned down. Deleting removes it from the board for good, with its discussion notes.

discussion.empty: No notes yet. Add the first one below.
discussion.label: New note

delete.hint: For an improvement made by mistake. Its feedback goes back to be decided.
delete.title: Delete this improvement?
delete.description: “{title}” is deleted for good. Its feedback goes back to be decided, and the lesson stays as it is.

places.removed: Lesson {position} is no longer part of this improvement.
places.added: Lesson {position} added. The plan covers it too: say what changes there.
places.leaveCourse: Leave the main course as it is
places.leaveCourseHint: Only the group’s copy changes. Proposed changes waiting on the main course’s lesson go.
places.leftCourse: The main course stays as it is.

aiReady.label: Ready for the AI agent
aiReady.hint: The agent may take this revision over end to end. Off, it only assists whoever edits the lesson.

plan.label: Revision plan
plan.placeholder: What will change in the lesson, where, and why.

groupOnly.title: This group only
groupOnly.text: Their examples, pace or tools. The main course stays as it is.

groupAndCore.title: Group and main course
groupAndCore.text: Saving the group’s lesson puts the same changes on the main course’s lesson, to review there.

scopes.noCourseLesson: The main course has no lesson to change: this one was added in the group’s copy. Suggest it for the course instead.

plan.draftReady: Draft ready. Edit it if needed, then save.
plan.noLesson: This improvement is not about a lesson, so there is nothing to plan from.

aiDraft.leave: You can leave this page. The draft is saved and waits here when it’s ready.
aiDraft.inClaude: In your Claude. The plan appears here when it sends it.
aiDraft.send: Send the message in the Claude tab that opened. The plan appears here when Claude sends it.
aiDraft.notStarted: Claude hasn’t started yet. In that chat, turn on the Chalkenso connector (＋ → Connectors) and send the message again.

path.label: Where this improvement is
path.toReview: {count, plural, one {# to review} other {# to review}}

next.reviewChanges: {count, plural, one {Review # proposed change} other {Review # proposed changes}}

work.toReview: {count, plural, one {# change to review} other {# changes to review}}
work.plans: {count, plural, one {plan to write} other {# plans to write}}
work.feedback: {count, plural, one {# new to decide} other {# new to decide}}
work.unpublished: learners don’t see the changes yet
work.used: {count, plural, one {# piece of feedback} other {# pieces of feedback}}
work.plansToUpdate: {count, plural, one {plan to update} other {# plans to update}}
work.plansReady: {count, plural, one {plan ready} other {# plans ready}}

improvements.doneNoChange: Done without a change to the lesson
improvements.publishBar: {count, plural, one {# lesson has saved changes learners don't see yet.} other {# lessons have saved changes learners don't see yet.}}
improvements.publishTitle: {count, plural, one {Publish this lesson?} other {Publish # lessons?}}
improvements.publishDescription: Learners see the saved changes from now on, and the feedback they answer is marked done.
improvements.empty: Nothing to improve here right now.

record.title: What changed
record.draft: saved as a draft, learners don’t see it yet
record.publishDescription: Learners see the lesson as it’s saved now, with this change.
record.notRecorded: What changed wasn’t recorded for this one: it was saved before Chalkenso kept a record.
record.nothing: Nothing was saved for it. It was marked done without a change to the lesson.
record.statusDraft: Saved as a draft · learners don’t see it yet
record.statusWaiting: Changes wait for review on the main course
